$~\¶@Phrase stage par nazar aata hai, jis rang, chamak aur harkat mein aap chahein.¶
Jumla(
	'hello!'
	6m
	rang: 🌈(60% 90 200°)
	haala: Haala(🌈(80% 80 200°) 0.3m)
	rukna: Silsila.lehrana(8°)
)\

chehre: ['🙂' '😮' '😎' '🤩']

$~\¶Matn ko sajaayein aur use chunne ke qaabil banayein.¶
phal: ƒ(e•'') Jumla(e 3m naam: e chunaJaSakneWala: ⊤)
chunaGaya: Intikhaab()
dikhayaGaya: '?' … ∆ chunaGaya … chunaGaya
Group(
	Tah(haashiya: 1m)
	[
		Jumla(dikhayaGaya 4m)
		Group(Qataar(haashiya: 1m) [phal('🍎') phal('🍐') phal('🍒')])
	]

example.letters:
$~\¶Programs se baat karein aur fonts aur nishaanon ki shakal istemaal karein.¶
paighaam: Guftagu()
lafz: 'hi' … ∆ paighaam … paighaam
line: Khaaka(lafz 'Noto Sans' 8m)
tick: 0 … ∆ Waqt(30ms) … tick + 1
dikhayaGaya: ((line.lambaai() × tick) ÷ 66).golNeechay() + 1
nuqtay: line.hissa(1 dikhayaGaya).badlo(
		ƒ(p) Jumla('•' jagah: p)
	)
Stage(nuqtay.saath(Jumla(lafz 8m dhundlapan: 15%)))\

language.title: $~Wordplay ek programming zubaan hai
bullets: $~• Har program ek izhaar hai jo ek qeemat ban jaata hai. \1 + 1\ ek program hai, aur \Jumla('hi')\ bhi.
• Adaad ke saath unit hoti hai, is liye \1m + 1m\ meter hai, aur \1cat + 1dog\🪲 ek ghalati hai jo @wordplay chalne se pehle pakad leta hai.
• Functions woh qeematein hain jinhein aap naam de sakte hain, aage de sakte hain, aur bula sakte hain: \ƒ dugna(n2•#) n2 × 2\.
• Jab input badalta hai, to @wordplay aapke program ko dobara chalata hai aur uski nayi qeemat dikhata hai. Events ka jawaab dene ki zaroorat nahin.
• @wordplay program chalne se pehle ghaltiyan dhoondta hai, aur har masle ki wazaahat karta hai.

multilingual.title: $~Wordplay kai zubaanon mein hai
bullets: $~• Programming zubaan ki har khaasiyat ka har zubaan mein ek naam hai, is liye code un alfaaz mein parha jaata hai jo aap pehle se jaante hain.

• Aap ke apne naam bhi kai zubaanon mein ho sakte hain:
\cat2/ur, gato/es: '🐈'
Jumla(cat2)\
• Matn ke saath ek zubaan hoti hai, aur woh aap ke dekhne walon ki zubaan dikhata hai: \'salaam'/ur'hola'/es\.
• Yeh site 29 zubaanon mein hai aur aap ek waqt mein ek se zyada chun sakte hain; matn har ek mein nazar aata hai.
• Aap @wordplay ka tarjuma karne mein bhi madad kar sakte hain, seedha app ke andar <localize@://localize> par.

accessible.title: $~Wordplay sab ke liye qaabil-e-rasaai hai
bullets: $~• Jo kuch aap mouse se kar sakte hain, woh keyboard se bhi kar sakte hain.
• Screen reader stage ka haal bayaan karte hain jaise woh badalta hai, aur ikhtiyaari aawaazein batati hain ke kya dobara chala, kya harkat mein hai, aur kya takraaya.
• Aap apna code matn ki bajaye blocks ki shakal mein parh aur likh sakte hain, aur jab chahein badal sakte hain.
• Harkat ko dheema kiya ja sakta hai, ya bilkul band kiya ja sakta hai.
• Bolay gaye output ko stage par likh kar dikhaya ja sakta hai un ke liye jo sun nahin sakte.

senses.title: $~Wordplay duniya ko mehsoos karta hai
bullets: $~• Waqt ka guzarna: \Waqt(1000ms)\ tik tik karta hai, aur \Abhi()\ aap ke apne calendar aur time zone mein aaj ki tareekh jaanta hai.
• Aap ke dekhne wale kahan ishaara karte hain, kya chhoote hain, aur kaun si kunjiyan dabate hain.
• Programs aap ke mic ka jawab de sakte hain: @Volume se aawaaz kitni tez hai, @Pitch se sur kaisa hai, aur @Speech se kaun se alfaaz bole gaye.
• Aap ke dekhne wale @Chat mein likh sakte hain, aur @Choice se stage ka maujood chun sakte hain.
• Programs us music ki dhun par bhi jawab de sakte hain jo woh bajate hain, @Beat ke saath.

performs.title: $~Wordplay pesh karta hai
bullets: $~• @Phrase stage par alfaaz aur emoji rakhta hai.
• @Group unhein qataron, dheron, jaalon mein, ya jahan aap chahein wahan saja deta hai.
• @Pose aur @Sequence cheezon ko ghumate, dhundhla karte, bada chhota karte aur hilate hain.
• @Say matn dikhane ke bajaye usay bol kar sunata hai.

• @Music asli saazon par suron ke track bajata hai, ek raftaar aur ek kunji ke mutabiq:
\Mauseeqi(
	Dhun([1 3 5] saaz: Saaz.ghanti)
	raftaar: 90beats/min
)\

typography.title: $~Wordplay khush-khati hai
bullets: $~• Sainkdon andaaz, jo duniya ke likhne ke nizaamon ko shaamil karte hain.
• Aap apne <khud ke banaye huye huroof@://characters> bana sakte hain aur jahan emoji aata hai wahan istemaal kar sakte hain.
• Har harf ka khaaka aisa data hai jo aap parh sakte hain aur hilaa sakte hain, @Contour ke saath: \Khaaka('a' 'Noto Sans')\.
• Matn us zubaan ke usool ke mutabiq lapeta jaata hai jis mein woh likha gaya ho.
• Daayen se baayen aur khadi likhaai bhi bilkul sahi tareeqe se lagai jaati hai.

docs.title: $~Wordplay khud ko samjhata hai
bullets: $~• Wazahati tehreer @Doc ke saath zubaan ka hissa hai, kisi tabsire ki tarah paas mein nahin.
• Talaash karne ke qaabil <rehnuma@://guide> har andar bani khaasiyat ko misaalon ke saath samjhata hai.
• Har ghalti wahin samjhai jaati hai jahan hui, aap ki zubaan mein.
• Aap program ko aage /aur/ peeche qadam ba qadam chala kar dekh sakte hain ke kya hua.
• Qadam chalate waqt har qeemat usi code mein dikhai jaati hai jis ne use banaya.

sharing.title: $~Wordplay baantne ke liye hai
bullets: $~• Aap ki mansoobe aap ke apne hain, aur aap tay karte hain ke unhein kaun dekh sakta hai.
• Aap doosre logon ko apne saath mansooba banane ke liye bula sakte hain.
• <Numaish gaahein@://galleries> kisi mauzu par mansoobon ko jama karti hain.
• Ustaad classein bana kar apne shagirdon ka kaam dekh sakte hain: <teach@://teach>.
• Aap kisi ka bhi aam mansooba naye andaaz mein bana kar apna bana sakte hain.

free.title: $~Wordplay muft aur khula hai
bullets: $~• @wordplay muft hai aur hamesha muft rahega.
• Yeh open source hai: aap parh sakte hain ke yeh kaise kaam karta hai aur ise badalne mein hamari madad kar sakte hain.
• Yeh <University of Washington@https://ischool.uw.edu/> ke Information School se aaya hai.
• Yahan banane walon, ustaadon aur madad karne walon ki ek jamaat hai.
• <Atiyaat@://donate> se isse chalane ka kharcha poora hota hai.

content: $~Kya aapko kabhi laga ke coding sirf un logon ke liye hai jo angrezi achi tarah bolte hain, jinko koi maazoori nahin, aur jo maghrib mein computer ke saath bade hue?
Haan, hamein bhi aisa laga.

Yeh koi ittefaq nahin. Computer ke aaghaz se hi programming zubaanein zyadatar ek hi tarah ke logon ne banayi hain -- zyadatar gore, angrezi bolne wale mard, jo America aur Europe ke idaron aur sanaat mein kaam karte the, aur kuch kamaal ki khawateen riyaazi daan. Unhon ne yeh kaam us daur mein kiya jab nau-abaadiyaati taqat ka raaj tha, aur programming zubaanein us taqat ko mazboot rakhne ka aham zariya thin.
Is tareekh ki wajah se computing ka tasawwur zyadatar raftaar, mantiq, munaafa aur ghalba paane ke gird ghoomta hai.

Yeh na-insaafi hai. Kyunki computing ab hamari rozmarra zindagi mein nazar aane aur na nazar aane wale tareeqon se shaamil hai, aur jin logon ko isse kuch banane ka mauqa milta hai woh zyadatar isse banane walon jaise hi hain. Baaqi insaaniyat is taqat ke aage majboor rehti hai, kyunki kuch alag sochne ke liye parhna likhna aana zaroori hai, jis par zubaan ki rukawatein, rasaai ki rukawatein, maali rukawatein, aur sarkari taleem mein na-barabari ka pehra hai.

*Wordplay* is ko badalne mein madad karna chahta hai. Yeh ek programming platform hai jo poori duniya ke liye banaya gaya hai, jo duniya ki /tamaam/ zubaanon ko sahaara deta hai, aur duniya ki zubaanon ke /baare/ mein bhi hai. Aisa platform jahan har koi apni salahiyat ke mutabiq kuch bana sake, aur aisa mawaad baant sake jo koi bhi mehsoos kar sake. Un naujawanon aur bachchon ke liye jo alfaaz, emoji aur typography ke zariye khelte hue aur fankaarana andaaz mein apne aap ko zaahir karna chahte hain. Maqsad apne liye taqat hasil karna nahin, balki aisi computing ki duniya banana hai jo hamare khoobsurat farq ki azeem taqat aur zaroorat ko tasleem kare.

Hum designers, ustaadon aur developers ki ek jamaat hain jo is khwab ko haqeeqat banane ki koshish kar rahe hain. Hum rang daar log hain, hum trans hain, hum queer hain, hum maazoor hain, hum musaafir hain, hum panaah guzeen hain. Hamara markaz Seattle, Washington, USA mein <University of Washington@https://washington.edu> ke <Information School@https://ischool.uw.edu/> mein hai, aisi jagah jo sab ko khush aamdeed kehna chahti hai aur nau-abaadiyaat ke un nuqsanaat ko mitana chahti hai jo maazoori aur nasl parasti se judey hain aur aaj bhi jaari hain. Yeh programming zubaan aur platform banana us mishan ka ek chhota sa hissa hai, jo computing ke aise mustaqbil ki jhalak dikhata hai jahan /har koi/ shaamil hai.

Hamein aapki madad chahiye. Seekhein <kaise hissa dalein@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/wiki/contribute>, <chanda dein@://donate>, ya hamari <pesh raft@https://github.com/amyjko/wordplay/milestones> dekhein. Agar koi sawaal ho to hamari jamaat ki muntazim <Amy@https://amyjko.phd> ko likhein.
$~Kya aap tay kar rahe hain ke *Wordplay* aapke school ya zile mein istemaal ke liye theek hai? Yahan hum jo wada kar sakte hain aur jo nahin kar sakte, woh likha hai.

Hum koi company nahin hain. Hum ek community par mabni tehqeeqi mansooba hain jo ek ghair munafa bakhsh university mein chalta hai, aur hamari koi aamdani nahin hai. Is ka matlab hai ke kuch muaahide hain jin par hum dastakhat nahin kar sakte, chahe hum kitna hi madad karna chahein. Hum yeh wada nahin kar sakte ke agar kisi zile par muqadma ho to hum uski qanooni fees ada karein. Hum yeh wada nahin kar sakte ke kisi masle ko tay shuda waqt par theek karein. Aisa wada karna jo hum nibha na sakein kisi ke kaam nahin aata, aapke to bilkul nahin.

Hum jo wada kar sakte hain, woh yeh hai. Hum platform ko /WCAG 2.2 Level AA/ accessibility par rakhte hain, har tabdeeli par usay khud-ba-khud jaanchte hain, aur jo masle milte hain unhein utni jaldi theek karte hain jitni jaldi ek razakaar community kar sakti hai. Hum platform istemaal karne walon ke bare mein kam se kam maloomaat jama karte hain, aur sirf platform chalane ke liye istemaal karte hain. Hamara <huqooq@://rights> safha bilkul sahi batata hai ke hum kya mehfooz rakhte hain, aur hamara <maakhaz code@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay> sab ke liye khula hai, is liye aap yeh sab khud jaanch sakte hain.

Yeh platform hamesha badalta rehta hai, aur woh qaidey bhi badalte hain jin par aapko chalna hota hai. Agar aapko koi aisi cheez chahiye jo hum abhi nahin karte, to hi@wordplay.dev par humein likhein aur batayein. Nigraan isay parhenge, aur hum jawab likhenge.

content: $~Salaam!

Aayiye aap ke aur hamare haqooq ke baare mein kuch baatein saaf kar lein (saath hi policy ke hawale se bhi, jaise <COPPA@https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-16/chapter-I/subchapter-C/part-312> aur <GDPR@https://gdpr.eu/compliance-checklist-us-companies/>).

Sab se pehli baat yeh jaanein ke hum koi tijaarati idaara nahin hain. Hum ek bhaichaare par mabni tehqeeqi mansooba hain, jo ek munafa na kamaane wali university mein chalta hai. Hamara maqsad ek aisa platform banana hai jo aap ko khushi de aur hamein computing ki ek ziyada munsifaana aur insaaf par mabni duniya ke baare mein naye inkishaafat karne mein madad de. Hamein is platform se paise kamaane mein koi dilchaspi nahin; jo bhi paisa hum jama karte hain (aam taur par sarkari imdaad se) woh platform ko chalaane ke liye istemaal hota hai, kisi ko ameer karne ke liye nahin jo is par kaam karta hai (ya is mein hissa daalta hai).

Chunke hum munafa nahin chahte, is ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke hum platform ke bharosemand hone, dastiyaab hone, ya lambe arse tak chalne ke baare mein koi wada nahin kar sakte. Phir bhi, <Amy@https://amyjko.phd> ne lambe arse tak ise chalaane ka pakka irada kiya hai, aur woh ek mustaqil professor hain, is liye unki naukri kaafi mehfooz hai.
Is se hum *data* par aate hain. Yeh woh cheezein hain jo hum jama karte hain aur cloud mein mehfooz rakhte hain:

• Aap ki *mansoobe*. Aap jo bhi mansoobe dete hain aur un mein aap ki tabdeeliyan hum mehfooz rakhte hain, siwaaye un mansoobon ke jin mein zaati shanakht wali maloomaat nazar aayein, jaise phone number, email pate, user naam, tax shanakhti nambar, ya ghar ke pate.
• Aap ki *settings*. In mein woh zubaanein shaamil hain jo aap chunte hain, aap ki animation pasand, aur sabaq mein aap ki pesh raft. Baaki sab kuch sirf aap ke device par mehfooz hota hai.

• Mujmooi *sargarmi*. Hum login aur aap ke dekhe gaye safhe gin lete hain, magar is tarah nahin ke aap ki shanakht ho sake, ya aap ko poori site par ya doosri sites par dhoonda ja sake. Hum Google Analytics ko 'consent denied' mode mein istemaal karte hain, jo safhon ke dekhe jaane ke baare mein sirf bohat kam aisi maloomaat jama karta hai jis se shanakht na ho, na cookies mehfooz karta hai, aur na IP address ki maloomaat Google ko bhejta hai. Hum yeh mujmooi maloomaat funding hasil karne mein madad ke liye istemaal karte hain, yeh batane ke liye ke platform kitna istemaal ho raha hai.

• Aap ki *chat ke tarjume*. Agar aap kisi chat ko doosri zubaan mein parhne ko kehte hain, to hum doosron ke paighaam ka tarjuma karte hain, magar aap ke apne paighaam ka kabhi nahin. Kuch browsers yeh tarjuma aap ke device par hi kar sakte hain, aur jab aap ka browser kar sake, to hamein kuch nahin bheja jaata. Warna paighaam ek AI tarjume ki khidmat ko jaate hain (abhi woh Claude hai, jo Anthropic ne banaya hai), aur tarjuma chat ke saath mehfooz kar liya jaata hai taake us mein shaamil kisi aur ko wohi alfaaz dobara tarjuma na karne parein. Sirf us chat mein shaamil log ise parh sakte hain.

Hum is ke ilaawa kuch aur mehfooz nahin karte. Hamara <maakhaz code@https://github.com/amyjko/wordplay/tree/main/src> sab ke liye khula hai, is liye koi bhi is ki tasdeeq kar sakta hai, aur kisi ghair iradi nigraani ki ittilaa de sakta hai.
*Aap* apne data ke maalik hain, hum nahin. Is ka matlab hai:

• Aap tay karte hain ke aap ki mansoobon tak kaun pahunch sakta hai. Yeh pehle se nijee hote hain, lekin aap inhein kisi shakhs ya guroh ke saath baant sakte hain, ya inhein poori tarah aam kar sakte hain.
• Aap kisi bhi waqt koi bhi mansooba ya apna account poori tarah mita sakte hain.
• Aap kisi bhi waqt kisi mansoobe ya apne poore account ki nakal (export) hasil kar sakte hain.
Hum aap ka data kaise istemaal karenge aur kaise nahin:

• Hum aap ka data kisi ke saath nahin baantenge, siwaaye is ke ke qanoon saaf taur par taqaza kare. Yeh hamesha mumkin hai ke aap ka data bina ijaazat le liya jaye (ek 'data breach'). Agar hamein pata chala ke aisa hua hai, to hum aap ko us email ke zariye ittilaa denge jo aap ne hamein diya hai.

• Hum aap se aap ke email pate par rabta nahin karenge, siwaaye is ke ke 1) aap account mein aisi tabdeeli karein jis ke liye hamein karna parey, 2) aap saaf taur par hamein rabta karne ki ijaazat dein, ya 3) upar bayaan kiye gaye data breach ki soorat mein.

• Hum platform par mansoobon, numaish gahon, aur tareeqa guide ke mawaad ka jaiza le sakte hain taake samajh sakein ke sab log kya bana rahe hain aur kaise bana rahe hain. Hum yeh mujmooi, bina naam ki baatein taleemi ishaaton mein baant sakte hain. Hum yeh sirf ek idaarati jaiza board ki nigraani mein karenge, jaisa ke Amreeki wafaaqi qanoon ka taqaza hai.

Aakhir mein, bolne ke baare mein ek baat. Mansoobe pehle se nijee hote hain, aur kisi khaas logon ke saath baantne se woh nijee hi rehta hai. Neeche likha hai ke aap jo baantte hain use kaun dekhta hai, is baat par ke use kaun dekh sakta hai.

Lekin kisi mansoobe ko *aam* karna, ya use kisi aam numaish gah mein shaamil karna, ek izzat ki baat hai. Yeh platform mohabbat, tasdeeq, ehtiram, aur wiqaar ke liye banaya gaya hai. Is liye hum umeed karte hain ke aap ka koi bhi *aam* mawaad aisa nahin hoga jo:
consequences: $~Agar hamein koi mansooba ya numaish gah mile jo in usoolon ki khilaaf warzi karti ho, to hum banane walon ko dekhne se pehle khabardaar karenge, ya usay dekhne se rok denge. Agar aap baar baar in usoolon ki khilaaf warzi karein, to aap logon ke saamne post karne ka haq kho denge.
warnings: $~Agar aap ka public content in usoolon ko tore, to bilkul yeh hota hai. Ek nigraan usay dekhta hai, woh public nahin rehta, aur aap ko apni notifications mein ek khabardaari milti hai jis mein likha hota hai ke kaunsa usool toota. Har signed in shakhs public content par report button se nigraan se kehsakta hai ke usay dekhein.

Teen khabardaariyon ke baad bhi aap mansoobe bana sakte hain, unhein apne chune hue logon ke saath baant sakte hain, aur yahan baaqi sab kuch istemaal kar sakte hain. Aap sirf kisi cheez ko public karne ka haq kho dete hain.

Agar aap ko lagta hai ke khabardaari ghalti se mili, ya woh bohat pehle ki baat hai aur aap dobara public karna chahte hain, to hi@wordplay.dev par likhein aur hamein apna username aur wajah batayein. Ek insaan usay parhega.
license: $~Mansooba *public* karne ke baare mein ek baat aur. Public mansoobe <Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike license@https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/> ke tehat baante jaate hain. Iska matlab hai ke koi bhi aap ke public mansoobe ko /Remix/ kar sakta hai, yaani us ki apni copy bana kar usay badal sakta hai, aur aap bhi kisi aur ke mansoobe ko remix kar sakte hain.

Is license ke saath teen cheezein aati hain. Remix karne walon ko asal banane wale ka naam dena hota hai. Unhein apna remix isi license ke tehat baantna hota hai, taake woh agle shakhs ke liye khula rahe. Aur woh kisi public mansoobe ko private karke apne paas nahin rakh sakte.

Naam dene mein hum madad karte hain: jab koi mansooba remix karta hai, to hum yaad rakhte hain ke woh kahan se aaya aur us ka link dikhate hain. Mansooba public karna in sab ke liye haan kehne ka tareeqa hai, is liye agar aap nahin chahte ke koi mansooba remix ho, to usay private rakhein.
research: $~Aakhri intikhab, aur yeh poori tarah aap ka hai. Hum kabhi kabhi Wordplay ke baare mein likhte aur baat karte hain, jaise research papers mein, taqreeron mein, aur ustaadon aur gharwalon ko dikhaane mein. Hum chahte hain ke log is se jo kuch banate hain woh dikhayein, lekin hum aap ka mansooba tab tak nahin dikhayenge jab tak aap ijaazat na dein.

Har mansoobe ki sharing options mein ek *Research* setting hoti hai, aur woh shuru mein band hoti hai. Isay on karne se hum us ek mansoobe ko misaal ke taur par dikha sakte hain, aap ke naam, username, ya aisi kisi cheez ke baghair jo bataye ke account aap ka hai. Yeh har mansoobe ke liye alag hai, is liye ek ke liye haan kehne ka baaqiyon se koi taalluq nahin.

Aap isay kabhi bhi band kar sakte hain. Band karne ka matlab hai ke hum aap ka mansooba kisi nayi cheez mein istemaal karna band kar denge, lekin jo cheez hum pehle shaya ya pesh kar chuke hain usay wapas nahin liya ja sakta.
responsibility: $~Aap ki baanti hui cheez ko kaun dekhta hai, yeh is par hai ke usay kaun dekh sakta hai.
• *Kisi ke saath nahin baanta, ya sirf unhi logon ke saath jin ke naam aap ne diye.* Isay koi nahin dekhta. Na hum, na koi aur.

• *Aisi numaish gah mein jis mein doosre log bhi hon.* Us numaish gah ke nigraan usay dekhte hain, aur us ke saath ki chats ko bhi. Yeh is baat se qata nazar hai ke numaish gah public hai ya nahin: us mein maujood log aap ka kaam dekh sakte hain, is liye wahan kisi ki zimmedaari hoti hai.
• *Public numaish gah mein.* Us ke nigraan usay dekhte hain, aur hum bhi, kyunke koi bhi usay dhoondh sakta hai.
• *Public, aur kisi numaish gah mein nahin.* Hum usay dekhte hain.
Jo bhi kisi cheez ko dekh sakta hai woh us par report button se kehsakta hai ke usay dekha jaaye. Hum banane wale ko kabhi nahin batate ke kis ne kaha.

design.description: $~Yeh @wordplay ke nazar aane wale naqshe ke nizaam ka hawala hai, jis mein rang, font, faasle, aur dobara istemaal hone wale hisse shaamil hain. Hissa daalne ke liye <design wiki@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/wiki/design> aur <develop wiki@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/wiki/develop> ki rehnumaiyan dekhein.
design.seasonsDescription: $~Mausam saaf ke rang badal dete hain aur uske kinaaron mein mausam ke nishaan jod dete hain. Har mausam roshan aur andheray ke saath ek doosra rukh hai, jis mein dono ke liye rangon ka set hota hai, aur har set ko shaamil hone se pehle woh hi contrast ki jaanch paas karni hoti hai jo asal set karta hai. Har mausam ke rang aur nishaan <mausam ke maakhaz@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/tree/main/src/seasons> mein data ki shakal mein hain.
accessibilityRules: $~Jo kuch bhi *matn* ki shakal mein nazar aaye, woh AA matn ke rangon mein se ek istemaal kare (*--color-gold-text*, *--color-grey-text*, *--color-blue-text*, *--color-orange-text*, ya koi maani wala mutaghayyar jo inmein se kisi ki taraf ishara karta ho), jo 4.5:1 contrast poora karte hain jo <WCAG 2.2@https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/> ka taqaza hai. Zyada chamakdaar rang sirf peeche ke rang, kinaaron, aur numayaan karne ke liye hain, jinhein 3:1 chahiye ya kuch nahin. Yeh nisbatein unit tests aur har safhe ki khudkaar jaanch se, roshan aur andhere dono mode mein, laagu ki jaati hain. Ek jaan boojh kar rakhi gayi mustasna: roshan mode mein kinaare ka grey 3:1 se neeche hai, kyunke yahan kinaare sirf sajaawati alag karne ke liye hain aur har zaroori hadd ke saath koi aur nishaani bhi hoti hai.

Kabhi sirf rang se matlab na batayein: har rang se bataye gaye haalat ke saath ek doosri nishaani bhi dein: koi shakal, lakeer ka andaaz, koi nishaan, ya koi lafz. Misaal ke taur par, editor caret ka numayaan hissa aur bade masle *thos* lakeer se, chuna hua output *toota hua* lakeer se, aur chhote masle *nuqton wali* lakeer se banata hai, taa ke shiddat aur intikhaab rang ke baghair bhi alag nazar aayein.
Poori hidayaat ke liye <design wiki@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/wiki/design> ki rehnuma dekhein.
logoDescription: $~Wordplay ka logo ek baat karne ka bubble hai jis mein ek harf hai: ek chhota sa stage jis par bubble kuch bhi keh sakta hai: parhne wale ke likhne ke nizaam ka harf, ek emoji, ya jab kuch load ho raha ho to gola, tikona, aur chaukor. App mein, harf aap ki pehli zubaan ke likhne ke nizaam ke mutabiq hota hai; browser icon aur share ki tasveeron jaisi jagahon par, jahan koi khaas likhaai nahin hoti, bubble teen shakalein dikhata hai, jo kuch banane ko tayyar hain.

Naqsha khud kabhi harkat nahin dikhata. Harkat rawaiye mein hai: landing page bubble ke kehne ko zubaan chunne wale ke saath saath badalti hai, aur load hote waqt shakalein baari baari uchhalti hain, jaise log lehar banate hon, aur yeh hamesha animation ki raftaar ki tarteeb ke mutabiq hoti hai, aur animation band hone par bilkul ruk jaati hai.
Nishaan hamesha maujooda matn ke rang mein banaya jaata hai, is liye jahan bhi matn contrast ki shartein poori karta hai, wahan logo bhi karta hai.
